mapper.sql: a.server_id, a.token_hash, a.issue_dt, a.issue_user, a.last_report_dt, a.last_report_ip, a.agent_host, a.agent_os, a.agent_ver, a.peer_status, a.collect_yn, a.collect_interval_sec, a.shutdown_req_yn, a.daemon_state, a.daemon_pid, a.daemon_start_dt, a.last_poll_dt, a.ctl_user, a.ctl_dt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM tb_agent a ORDER BY a.server_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_agent (server_id, token_hash, issue_dt, issue_user) VALUES (#{serverId}, #{tokenHash}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{issueUser})
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_agent SET last_report_dt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, last_report_ip = #{lastReportIp}, agent_host = #{agentHost}, agent_os = #{agentOs}, agent_ver = #{agentVer}, peer_status = #{peerStatus} WHERE server_id = #{serverId}

UPDATE tb_agent SET daemon_start_dt = CASE WHEN daemon_pid IS NULL OR daemon_pid <> #{daemonPid} OR daemon_state = 'STOPPED' OR daemon_start_dt IS NULL THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE daemon_start_dt END, daemon_pid = #{daemonPid}, daemon_state = #{daemonState}, last_poll_dt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, agent_ver = COALESCE(#{agentVer, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, agent_ver) WHERE server_id = #{serverId}
UPDATE tb_agent SET shutdown_req_yn = 'N', daemon_state = 'STOPPING' WHERE server_id = #{serverId}
UPDATE tb_agent SET daemon_state = 'STOPPED', last_poll_dt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE server_id = #{serverId}
UPDATE tb_agent SET collect_yn = #{collectYn}, shutdown_req_yn = #{shutdownReqYn}, ctl_user = #{ctlUser}, ctl_dt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE server_id = #{serverId}
UPDATE tb_agent SET collect_interval_sec = #{sec}, ctl_user = #{ctlUser}, ctl_dt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE server_id = #{serverId}
